name: capsicum + methyl salicylate
uses: Uses for the temporary relief of minor aches and pains of muscles and joints associated with: • simple backache • arthritis • strains • bruises • sprains
otcwarn: Warnings For external use only Do not use • other than as directed • on children under 12 years of age Keep out of reach of children. If swallowed, get medical help or contact a Poison Control Center right away.
